in_marathi.name: Ahilan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ahilan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ahilan is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ahilana', meaning 'Lord of the Universe'. This name is associated with the Hindu god Vishnu, who is believed to be the preserver of the universe. In Hindu mythology, Vishnu is often depicted as having the power to control all aspects of the universe.
